description: This file defines the SQLCollection class implementing database operations such as upsert, delete, count, and stream for a specific collection type within the Notesnook project. It includes methods for managing database items, filtering, grouping, and sorting, utilizing external query builders and utilities.

classes.name: SQLCollection
classes.description: A class providing database collection management including CRUD operations, filtering, grouping, and sorting for a specific collection type.

classes.name: FilteredSelector
classes.description: A helper class for filtering and retrieving items with specific criteria, supporting grouping, sorting, and iteration.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes all items from the collection.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates an item in the collection, handling sanitization and event publishing.

methods.name: softDelete
methods.description: Marks items as deleted without removing them from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes items from the database by their IDs.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an item with a given ID exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of non-deleted items.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an item by ID if it exists and is not deleted.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Bulk inserts or updates multiple items, sanitizing and handling remote flags.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates specific items by IDs with partial data, optionally sending events.

methods.name: records
methods.description: Fetches multiple items by IDs, returning a record map.

methods.name: unsyncedCount
methods.description: Counts items that are not synchronized.

methods.name: unsynced
methods.description: Async generator yielding chunks of unsynced items.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Async generator streaming items in chunks, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: createFilter
methods.description: Creates a filtered selector for querying items with custom criteria.
